---
title: Global Embedding Dataset 
---

The Global Embedding Dataset represents a dense, large-scale collection of satellite image embeddings derived from the Major TOM Core datasets: Major-TOM/Core-S2L1C, Major-TOM/Core-S2L2A, and Major-TOM/Core-S1RTC (Francis and Czerkawski, 2024). These datasets provide access to over 60 TB of AI-ready Copernicus data with multiple sensing modalities, including multi-spectral (MSI), true-color RGB, and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), at various processing levels.
